title: Lightweight provenance stamp for zero-touch request instrumentation across SDKs
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Introduce a compact, middleware-agnostic provenance stamp (x-rw-prov) that SDKs and language middlewares can attach to outgoing requests to carry trace linkage, sampling decision, and a minimal routing fingerprint. Goal: enable reliable request stitching and lightweight correlation for services that can’t or won’t run full OpenTelemetry SDKs without adding measurable latency or header bloat.
acceptance_criteria: SDKs (JS, Python, Go) successfully emit x-rw-prov on outbound HTTP/gRPC calls when request context exists
Stamp payload <= 48 bytes (base64) in common cases and decodes to: request_id, sampled_flag, trace_hint, version
Inbound collectors (edge proxy / runtime) read stamp and attach to internal tracing envelope when present
Falls back gracefully: if existing traceparent present, stamp does not conflict and is optional
No PII or secrets are encoded; stamp contains only stable IDs and flags
End-to-end benchmark: median added latency <= 150us on JS HTTP path and <= 100us on Python sync path for typical 95th %-tile request sizes
Automated unit + integration tests + compatibility tests with legacy clients (simulate older SDKs) are present
work_notes: 2026-02-10 Aisha Raman: Initial proposal drafted — lightweight base64 'provenance stamp' header to address missed-correlations for serverless and edge-proxied requests. Outlined format and constraints.

2026-02-16 Marco Diaz: Prototype implemented in JS SDK (fetch/axios wrappers) + small Go middleware. Microbench shows +120us median on Node 18 with a non-optimized encoder — need to optimize allocations.
2026-02-19 Design review (Lena Park): Concern about header name collision and visibility in logs. Decision: prefix with x-rw-prov and include version byte to allow future evolution.
2026-02-22 Security review: Confirmed no secrets/PII; stamp limited to 64-bit request_id + 8-bit flags + 16-bit route hash. Approved for beta. security_review_required=false
2026-02-26 Marco: Implemented compact binary packing and base64 URL-safe serialization; JS median impact reduced to +85us. Added process.env opt-out for edge cases.

2026-03-01 QA: Integration smoke with edge proxy (ENG-61234) — proxy correctly preserves header and runtime attaches to trace envelope. Found issue with gRPC metadata casing; added compatibility shim.

2026-03-04 PM check-in (Rita Chen): Request for fallback strategy documented — when both traceparent and x-rw-prov exist, runtime should prefer authoritative traceparent but use stamp for service routing hint. Added note to acceptance criteria.
